name: District and upazila portals (Mymensingh Division) — bus terminals, stands and railway stations named on transport pages
organization: Deputy Commissioner / Upazila Nirbahi offices (national portal framework)
attribution: District and upazila portals (*.gov.bd, Bangladesh National Portal)
notes: No licence stated. No portal publishes a terminal, station or ghat register; rows are names explicitly given on the 'যোগাযোগ ব্যবস্থা' / 'যোগাযোগ' pages of the Jamalpur DC portal and of the upazila portals that name one, and on the Mymensingh City Corporation's 'বাস টার্মিনাল' page (the Mymensingh DC page gives a 2019 train timetable and bus routes by departure place; the Sherpur and Netrokona DC pages name none). Dhaka-side terminals (Mohakhali, Kamalapur), stations outside the division (Kaoraid, on the Bhaluka page), bus company counters, departure places not called a stand or terminal, and route descriptions without a named stop are not rows. raw/ keeps, per page that gave a row, only the lines carrying the matched phrases (mobiles/e-mails redacted; descriptive text is not copied into the CSVs).
